# MeterMesh

> Verifiable AI work delivered over XMTP and grounded in X Layer receipts.

Canonical integration guide: /docs/
Service manifest: /.well-known/metermesh.json
Public HTTP read surfaces: /openapi.json
Captured offline evidence: /evidence/captured-session.json
Source: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh
Protocol schema: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh/blob/main/packages/protocol/src/schema.ts
Explanation schema: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh/blob/main/packages/ai/src/schema.ts

Execution is defined by signed MeterMesh envelopes carried over XMTP. No HTTP execution endpoint is published. The v1 public verifier creates no voucher and moves no funds. Buyer review is recorded as an unsigned preview. The proof-anchor contract is deployed on X Layer Testnet at 0xE9827c90f742C593F966B7E878e2a13fdC8f1683, and one fresh signed live proof is anchored in transaction 0xf518187f13559ab46cfa1c85d64089a8c99eca8d1ee9d77a41840046f0e7aa5a. OKX MPP session open, voucher, and settlement remain deferred until chain 1952 support is confirmed.
